Contents

Overview

XCAL-Mobile is a handheld based stand-alone application running on smart phones that enables QoS and QoE testing across all WCDMA, GSM, LTE, and 5GNR technologies. XCAL-Mobile application on smart phone in Android OS supports extensive application testing and delivers real-time network measurement and visualization.
XCAL-Mobile is provided for both indoor and outdoor measurement while it is also available for field drive test when it is installed inside of a moving vehicle. It supports remote control function by connecting with other server solution series of Accuver. All features can be controlled by using normal handset keys.

Special Features of XCAL-Mobile.v5.24

topic-0002, topic-0003, topic-0004

## Context (model-interpreted)
XCAL-Mobile is a handheld based stand-alone application running on smart phones that enables QoS and QoE testing across all WCDMA, GSM, which is the second-generation digital cellular standard and in measurement tools appears as a legacy radio access technology a terminal can fall back to, LTE, and 5GNR technologies. XCAL-Mobile application on smart phone in Android OS supports extensive application testing and delivers real-time network measurement and visualization, which is the treatment a network commits to for a given traffic flow - throughput, delay, loss, and priority. XCAL-Mobile is provided for both indoor and outdoor measurement while it is also available for field drive test when it is installed inside of a moving vehicle, and LTE is the fourth-generation 3GPP radio access technology, using OFDMA on the downlink and SC-FDMA on the uplink over an all-IP core.

Technology: CDMA/EVDO, WCDMA, LTE, LTE-A, GSM, TD-SCDMA, 5G-NR

Call Type: Voice, VoLTE, FTP, HTTP, SMS, E-Mail, Iperf, Ping, YouTube, Mobile SNS, Mobile Cloud, ADB Script, Messenger Talk, Messenger Texting, Netflix, Multi-Call, Multi-RAB, Multi-Session, Speed-Test, ARS-Incoming, MCPTT, PS Video, PS
RF Parameter: 5G NR Summary, 5G NR Signal, 5G NR Beam, 5G NR Inter RAT, ENDC Summary, LTE Summary, LTE CA, LTE Signal, LTE Cell, SCell Event, eMBMS LTE SIB, LTE Inter-RAT, NB-IoT RF, Cat M1 RF, LTE & Cat M1 RF, IoT Signaling Message, 3G Summary, 3G Signal, 3G Cell, GSM Summary, GSM Signal, GSM Cell, Android RF

Precautions of XCAL-Mobile application update(Reinstallation)

When updating the XCAL-Solo application to the latest version, the user must delete the application data only once after the latest version is installed.
If the user deleted the previous version before the version update, there is no need to delete the application data after the version update.
If the application data from the previous version is not deleted, the update might not be applied properly.
(For example, when the unnecessary feature from an older version is deleted in the new version, the new version may still have them.)

Starting XCAL-Mobile

By now, you have completed all necessary steps before starting and ready to use XCAL-Mobile application on your smart phone.

Before you start XCAL-Mobile, make sure;

1. Internet access is available.(Connect WIFi & Mobile data)
2. Automatically synchronizes the date and time.
- Samsung: Settings → General management → Date And Time → Automatic date and time is Checked
- LG: Settings → System → Date & time → Set automatically is Checked
- Sony: Settings → System → Date & Time → Automatic date and time is Checked

Starting XCAL-Mobile application

Run XCAL-Mobile and get a valid SW license. Request a license by sending an IMSI, IMEI, or MAC address to the Accuver sales team.

MAC address will not be shown when internet access (WiFi or 3G/4G/5G) is unavailable.

Graphic User Interface

XCAL-Mobile’s intuitive and user-friendly user interface helps your measurement projects.

Setting Icon

The setting icon in the top left corner configures overall settings in the Setting and Function item. All setting options can be simply approached by tapping this Setting icon. You can also open the settings/Functions menu by swiping the screen from left to right.

Settings Item

Setting items include Autocall/LogData/Control/Report/GPS/LogMask settings which are configured prior to the Autocall test.

Functions Item
Functions item includes other functions such as manual logging, replay, master/slave, capture, network lockrk Lock in the top rightg and about.

The menu icon in the top right corner configures overall Menu items. All menu items can be simply approached by tapping this Menu icon. You can also open the Menu by swiping the screen from right to left.

## Context (model-interpreted)
- 5G NR Summary(SCG): The 5G NR Summary(SCG) screen displays parameters of 5G NR SCG Pcell, where NR stands for New Radio, which is the fifth-generation 3GPP radio access technology that supports flexible subcarrier spacing, wide bandwidths, and beam-based operation. Select the SCG button in the upper left corner to activate the menu, where SCG stands for Secondary Cell Group, which in dual connectivity is the set of serving cells provided by the secondary node. The 5G NR Summary(SCG) screen displays parameters of 5G NR SCG Pcell, where Pcell stands for Primary Cell, which is the serving cell in the master cell group that carries the terminal's initial connection and anchors radio link failure and handover.
- 5G NR CA: 5G NR CA shows 5G NR CA information such as PCI, NR-ARFCN, which is the Absolute Radio-Frequency Channel Number, an integer that names a carrier frequency and maps to a centre frequency through a fixed 3GPP raster so equipment can refer to a channel without stating megahertz, Raster Frequency, SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SSB Index. 5G NR CA shows 5G NR CA information such as PCI, NR-ARFCN, Raster Frequency, SS-RSRP, which is the SS Reference Signal Received Power, the received power of the synchronisation signal block reference signal in dBm, and the cell- and beam-level strength measure used for cell selection and mobility, SS-RSRQ, and SSB Index. 5G NR CA shows 5G NR CA information such as PCI, NR-ARFCN, Raster Frequency, SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, which is the SS Reference Signal Received Quality, defined as SS-RSRP divided by the total received power on the same bandwidth, and it measures quality relative to interference rather than raw strength, and SSB Index.
- 5G NR CA(SCG): On 5G NR CA, which is a method of combining several component carriers so that one terminal transmits and receives over their summed bandwidth, raising peak throughput beyond what a single carrier allows, information such as PCI, NR-ARFCN, Raster Frequency, SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SSB Index is displayed.
- 5G NR Custom Graph: 5G NR Custom Graph shows the selected 5G NR parameters, which are part of New Radio, a fifth-generation 3GPP radio access technology that supports flexible subcarrier spacing, wide bandwidths, and beam-based operation, on the graph. Tap the Parameter Setting button to select RF parameters, which are part of the radio-frequency domain—the analogue signal path and the measurements taken on it, such as power and frequency—to display in the table.
- 5G NR Custom Graph(NRDC): 5G NR Custom Graph(NRDC) shows the selected 5G NR MCG/SCG RF parameter, which refers to a radio-frequency domain - the analogue signal path and the measurements taken on it, such as power and frequency - on the graph. 5G NR Custom Graph(NRDC) shows the selected 5G NR MCG/SCG RF parameter on the graph, where MCG stands for Master Cell Group, which in dual connectivity is the set of serving cells provided by the master node, including the primary cell. 5G NR Custom Graph(NRDC) shows the selected 5G NR MCG/SCG RF parameter on the graph, where NR stands for New Radio, which is the fifth-generation 3GPP radio access technology, supporting flexible subcarrier spacing, wide bandwidths, and beam-based operation. 5G NR Custom Graph(NRDC) shows the selected 5G NR MCG/SCG RF parameter on the graph, where SCG stands for Secondary Cell Group, which in dual connectivity is the set of serving cells provided by the secondary node.

- 5G NR Inter RAT: Display Cell Search information over 5G NR, which is the fifth-generation 3GPP radio access technology, or LTE, which is the fourth-generation 3GPP radio access technology. Tap the Parameter Setting button to select RF, which refers to the radio-frequency domain—the analogue signal path and the measurements taken on it, such as power and frequency—parameters to display in the table.
- 5G NR RACH: Display major RACH, which is the uplink channel a terminal uses to first contact a cell when it has no scheduled resources, KPIs for 5G NR in the table.
